key_insight: VEFX-Bench provides the first large-scale, human-annotated benchmark of complete video editing examples plus a standardized evaluator, enabling fair, reproducible comparison of generic video-editing and VFX systems.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of a comprehensive, human-labeled dataset and a unified evaluation protocol for instruction-guided video editing and visual effects, which has prevented consistent comparison and progress in the field.
method: Curate a large-scale dataset of raw videos paired with human-created, instruction-driven edited outputs and quality labels for common editing/VFX tasks.

Define a benchmarking suite of editing scenarios and an evaluation protocol that combines human quality annotations with objective metrics for fidelity, temporal consistency, and instruction compliance.
Provide a standardized evaluator and leaderboard to enable reproducible comparison across models and editing pipelines.
impact: Enables researchers and practitioners to benchmark video editing models on realistic, end-to-end editing tasks and accelerate progress by making evaluations reproducible and comparable across methods.
visual_elements: Before/after frame triplets (original, instruction, edited result) to illustrate example edits
Dataset composition chart showing task categories (color grading, compositing, removal, style transfer, temporal fixes) and size
Evaluation pipeline diagram combining human labels and automated metrics feeding into a leaderboard
Example leaderboard/scorecard comparing baseline methods across multiple metrics
paper_title: VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects
paper_authors: Xiangbo Gao, Sicong Jiang, Bangya Liu, Xinghao Chen, Minglai Yang
